question: At which of the following places Mangal Pandey was hanged till death for attacking his officers?
solution: The correct answer is __**Barrackpore**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Mangal Pandey**, a soldier in the **34th Bengal Native Infantry** of the British East India Company, was a key figure in the events leading to the Indian Rebellion of 1857. • Mangal Pandey attacked British officers on **March 29, 1857**, at the military garrison of **Barrackpore** near Kolkata (then Calcutta). • He was subsequently court-martialed and sentenced to death for his actions of rebellion and insubordination. • **Barrackpore**, a town in West Bengal, served as a major military cantonment under the British rule, and it was the location of this significant incident. • Mangal Pandey was hanged to death on **April 8, 1857**, at Barrackpore, making him one of the earliest martyrs of the Indian freedom struggle.
